name: Tent Block
description: A row of field tents providing sleeping quarters for recruits.

levels.description: Starter tent row. Capacity: 30 maidens.
Extended tent block. Capacity: 50 maidens.
Full tent compound. Capacity: 70 maidens.

name: Field Hospital
description: A medical facility that heals injured maidens between missions.

levels.description: Basic medical tent. Recovers 25% of max HP for injured maidens after each mission.
Proper field hospital. Recovers 33% of max HP for injured maidens after each mission.
Full surgical ward. Recovers 50% of max HP for injured maidens after each mission.

name: Factory
description: Produces weapons and gear from raw metal and wood.

levels.description: Basic workshop. Can craft common equipment.
Expanded factory. Can craft uncommon equipment.
Full manufacturing plant. Can craft rare equipment.
Advanced production facility. Can craft advanced-tier equipment.
State-of-the-art weapons plant. Can craft elite-tier equipment.

name: Radio Center
description: A communications hub for contacting Headquarters. HQ supplies equipment in exchange for gold — quality and rarity increase with each upgrade.

levels.description: Basic radio room. HQ shop Tier 1 — standard field gear. Shop: 1 weapon + 2 items.
Improved signal. HQ shop Tier 2 — improved standard issue. Shop: 1 weapon + 2 items.
Enhanced comms. HQ shop Tier 3 — professional grade equipment. Shop: 1 weapon + 2 items.
Secure channel. HQ shop Tier 4 — mid-tier specialist gear. Shop: 2 weapons + 3 items.
Dedicated HQ liaison. HQ shop Tier 5 — heavy field equipment. Shop: 2 weapons + 3 items.
Priority supply line. HQ shop Tier 6 — elite assault gear. Shop: 3 weapons + 4 items.
Classified channel. HQ shop Tier 7 — advanced tactical equipment. Shop: 3 weapons + 4 items.
Strategic command link. HQ shop Tier 8 — rare HQ supply. Shop: 4 weapons + 5 items.
Command relay station. HQ shop Tier 9 — legendary gear. Shop: 4 weapons + 5 items.
Supreme HQ channel. HQ shop Tier 10 — epic, game-changing equipment. Shop: 4 weapons + 5 items.

name: Training Grounds
description: A dedicated area where maidens improve their skills.

levels.description: Basic drills. Grants 10 theory EXP in all subjects to off-mission maidens after each mission.
Improved grounds. Grants 20 theory EXP in all subjects after each mission.
Elite facility. Grants 50 theory EXP in all subjects after each mission.

name: Farm
description: Fields and livestock that keep your maidens fed. Produces food after every concluded mission, regardless of outcome.

levels.description: Starter plot. Produces 200 food after each mission.
Expanded fields. Produces 300 food after each mission.
Large farm. Produces 400 food after each mission.
Industrial farm. Produces 500 food after each mission.
High-output cultivation complex. Produces 600 food after each mission.
Grand agri-fortress. Produces 700 food after each mission.

name: The Meridian
description: A formal review post staffed by an HQ liaison officer. After each mission, headquarters evaluates your unit's record and distributes financial support and materials based on performance.

levels.description: Formal HQ review post. Base support scales with a difficulty-weighted win score across your last 10 missions (Easy ×1 / Normal ×2 / Hard ×10 / Extreme ×40 — wins only). Final payout is further modified by kill count and force strength. Clean missions (≤10% losses) earn a stacking bonus; high-casualty missions apply stacking exponential penalties.

name: Rosarium Vocis
description: A sacred recruitment hall where the calls of battle are answered. Each victory carries a chance to inspire a new volunteer to join the cause — and veterans ensure they arrive properly equipped.

levels.description: A modest recruitment post. 20% chance of inspiring a free volunteer after each victory. New arrivals come with standard-issue gear (Rarity 1).
An expanded hall with better outfitting. 40% victory chance. Volunteers arrive with uncommon gear (Rarity 2). Recruit cost reduced to 250.
A prestigious hall that attracts seasoned volunteers. 60% victory chance. Volunteers arrive with rare gear (Rarity 3). Recruit cost reduced to 400.
A legendary hall renowned across Waelfeld. 80% victory chance. Volunteers arrive with very rare gear (Rarity 4), with heroines receiving legendary loadouts (Rarity 5).
